app.name: Buzz
app.description: Team chat on a self-hosted Buzz (Nostr) relay — humans and agents as signed members. Option B pilot: native PureDesktop surface, Block's relay underneath.

tools.name: getBuzzContext
tools.description: Current Buzz state: connection status, relay, own identity (npub and display name), the active channel, and which channels have unread messages.

tools.name: listChannels
tools.description: List every channel and direct-message conversation: id, name, type (channel|dm), visibility (open|private), member count, and whether it has unread messages.

tools.name: readMessages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a channel or DM, oldest first: author display name, text, ISO timestamp, attachments by name, and reply references. Edits and deletions are applied for the channel currently open in the app; other channels return the raw history.

channelId.description: Channel id from listChannels. Defaults to the active channel.

tools.name: searchMessages
tools.description: Full-text search within one channel via the relay. Returns matching messages, newest first.

channelId.description: Channel id to search. Defaults to the active channel.

tools.name: listMembers
tools.description: A channel's member roster: display name, npub, role, and whether they are online right now.

channelId.description: Channel id. Defaults to the active channel.

tools.name: sendMessage
tools.description: Post a message to a channel or DM as the user. The message is signed with their identity and visible to every member — use exactly the text the user approved.

channelId.description: Channel id from listChannels. Defaults to the active channel.

text.description: Message text (markdown subset: links, bold, italic, code).

tools.name: sendDirectMessage
tools.description: Send a direct message to one person as the user, opening the DM channel first if it does not exist. The message is signed with the user's identity — use exactly the text the user approved.

to.description: Who to message: a display name (see listMembers), an npub, or a hex key.

text.description: Message text (markdown subset: links, bold, italic, code).

tools.name: latestMessages
tools.description: The newest messages, newest first — from one channel, from one person across every channel, or both. "from" accepts a display name, npub, or hex key.

channelId.description: Channel id. Defaults to the active channel; omit together with "from" to search a person across all channels.

from.description: Only messages by this person — display name, npub, or hex key.

tools.name: listMedia
tools.description: Files and images posted in a channel: url, mime type, author, timestamp, message id. Optionally filtered to one person (display name, npub, or hex key).

channelId.description: Channel id. Defaults to the active channel.

from.description: Only media posted by this person.

tools.name: sendMediaFile
tools.description: Upload a local file to the relay media store and post it to a channel as the user, with an optional caption. Signed with their identity; images are re-encoded to strip metadata.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to send (max 10MB).

channelId.description: Channel id. Defaults to the active channel.

caption.description: Text to send with the file.
